row.notes: RaceStrategyViewModel populate (vtable 0x145749740; callers: activate 0x141d69270 via call 0x141d69278, and vtable+0xC0 handler 0x141d6f700 via call 0x141d6f81c). Returns WITHOUT filling the screen when: vm+0x26dd set (ctor writes word 0x100 at +0x26dc, activate clears it after its first populate - so the first call is always empty); player car = Sess_Get_PlayerVehicleIndex(vm+0x638, splitscreen flag vm+0x26d0) == 0xff; session data vm+0x630 has +0x70 == 0, or its per-car lists +0x38..+0x40 / +0x58..+0x60 are empty or shorter than the player index, or either entry is null. Entry type check: vcall [entry]+0 must return RaceSessionData type 0x1461015c8, else the other filler path (0x141d6c161 -> FUN_141d6ceb0). Then fills tyre/strategy rows (0x1436ae650 on vm+0x630 for the player car) and view-model fields. Strategy screen 'frame but empty centre' = one of these early returns on the second call. Placed in game (vm lane owned by ui-re). (used by vmknolle red-flag-pit strategy probe)
